definition: The disputed status of a material individual as one substance in its own right, rather than merely a collection or operationally integrated plurality. In the independence test this is a primitive metaphysical predicate, not defined by composition, survival, organismic activity or the presence of a soul.
note: Open research vocabulary for #325/#329, not a proof that substantial unity exists. Source traditions, criteria and their adequacy require independent justification. Keeping this predicate independent prevents a circular argument from life to soul.
